statement: Over every algebraically closed field, for A of dimension2 or3 the actual Jacobian-summand property is equivalent to P^(2g−2)/(2g−2)! belonging to the integral numerical cycle lattice of A x Adual; over C it is also equivalent to integral cohomological algebraicity.
depends_on: C.4n; C.4p; integral numerical Matsusaka identity; Scavia–Suzuki2025 Theorem1.2 and following paragraph with equation1.2; finite-free numerical lattice; Voisin2024 Theorem1.4; Beckmann–deGaayFortman2023 Theorem1.1
notes: All primes including crystalline p are retained. No Tate or standard conjecture D is used. Exact dimension-two cycle reformulation; no claim that the residual class is integral and no priority claim.

statement: Every supersingular abelian surface over every algebraically closed field of positive characteristic is an actual direct summand of a product of Jacobians.
depends_on: Fu–Li2021 Proposition6.1 p184 and Lemma6.2 p185; C.4f
notes: The source explicitly includes characteristic2; does not address all nonsupersingular surfaces.
